caption: The drawing depicts a stylized figure of a person with a crown of thorns, crucified on a cross. The cross is colored primarily in dark brown with alternating yellow and red rectangular sections on the horizontal bar, each containing the letter "B" in black or white. The figure has extended arms nailed to the crossbeam, and the hands and feet are depicted with clear red marks indicating wounds. The skin of the figure is colored in tan, and the figure is accentuated with strong red lines and spots suggesting blood, muscle, and wounds across the body. The rib cage, major joints, and muscles are outlined and shaded in red and brown. The loincloth of the figure is light tan with a red and black circular pattern at the center. The face is stylized with pronounced eyes, cheekbones, and a beard, using tan, red, and black colors. The number "27" is printed in small blue text at the bottom left corner of the drawing. The background is an off-white color, and the entire image is aligned vertically.
title: Plate 27: Christ Crucified: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
